en: A hand‑colored vintage postcard showing a panoramic view of a small European town with many trees and red‑roofed houses. On the left stands a church with a tower topped by a dome and weather vane. The town is surrounded by fields and forested hills in the background. At the bottom margin there is printed red text identifying the place and publisher, as well as a note that it is a hand‑colored art card.
